fact: The report states the Bomalathu Digital Services Platform has migrated to the National Data Centre in Lilongwe, which has a disaster recovery site in Blantyre, and that Government data hosting capacity was expanded by 115 TB.

The Department of e-Government, through the PPPC with World Bank DIGMAP funding, reported the Government Data Centre in Lilongwe 77 percent complete, to consolidate government-wide systems under one roof with Blantyre as backup, due December 2024.

The UN Economic Commission for Africa's digital trade regulatory profile of Malawi states that Malawi has local storage requirements only for health-related data, naming no instrument; the document gives no date of its own, so the 2022 publication date is used (its data covers 2014-2021).
